faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions
faq.q1: Is there any fee to apply for a job?
faq.a1: No, applying through Al-Mansoor is completely free. We never charge job seekers any fee.
faq.a2: You'll need a valid ID/passport, a passport-size photo, and any relevant experience certificates.
faq.q3: How long does it take to get a job?
faq.a3: It depends on the role and employer, but our team works to match and verify you as quickly as possible.
faq.q4: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a4: No account needed. You can apply directly with your phone number — we'll keep you updated via SMS/WhatsApp.
faq.q5: How do companies hire through Al-Mansoor?
faq.a5: Companies simply fill out our requirement form, and our team reaches out with verified candidates that match their needs.
